plan.title: Sample Half-Marathon Block
plan.athlete_notes: Illustrative plan showing the import schema. Not a real training block.
plan.race_course_notes: Flat loop course, one water stop every 3 km.
plan.north_star: Return to consistent easy running and one weekly long run.
plan.plan_logic: Aerobic base week with a single quality touch and a gated long run.
plan.medical_notes: Coaching guidance only, not medical advice.

phases.name: Aerobic base
phases.description: Easy volume with one controlled quality session.

weeks.coaching_note: Keep every easy run genuinely easy; the long run is gated on how the knee feels.
weeks.performance_target: Complete four runs at conversational effort.
weeks.injury_target: No knee pain above 2/10 during or after runs.
weeks.bike_note: Optional easy spin on the rest day.

sessions.title: Easy run
sessions.role: Open the week with relaxed aerobic running.
sessions.prescription_text: 6 km easy on soft surface, nose-breathing pace.
sessions.completion_planned: Planned: 6.0 km at easy effort, RPE 3.

sessions.title: Upper A
sessions.prescription_text: Push, pull, and core circuit. 2 rounds, RPE 6 cap.

sessions.title: Controlled fartlek
sessions.role: Introduce light quality without straining the knee.
sessions.prescription_text: 2 km easy, then 6 x 1 min steady / 1 min easy, then 2 km easy.
sessions.completion_planned: Planned: 8.0 km with 6 x 1 min steady.

sessions.title: Easy long run
sessions.role: Weekly aerobic long run, gated on knee status.
sessions.prescription_text: 14 km easy if green. See alternatives for yellow and red days.

alternatives.prescription: Shorten to 8-10 km easy, stop if pain rises.
No run. Easy 30 min bike or full rest.

milestones.title: First gated long run
milestones.description: The Sunday long run is green-gated on knee status.
milestones.green_criteria: Knee at or below 2/10 all week.
milestones.red_criteria: Pain above 3/10 or altered gait; do not run.

checkpoints.title: End of week 1 review
checkpoints.green_action: Progress volume next week as planned.
checkpoints.yellow_action: Hold volume flat and repeat the base week.
checkpoints.red_action: Reduce running and seek a clinical review.
